verified_title: XRAG: Extreme Cross-lingual Retrieval Augmented Generation
authors: Wang, Xiao; Liu, Yixin; Zhang, Yue; et al.
research_question: How can retrieval-augmented generation scale across diverse non-English queries and corpora?
evidence_representation: Passage retrieval with cross-lingual dense indexing
evaluation_design: End-to-end question answering accuracy and generation quality
main_finding: Retrieval in English corpora improves non-English QA if cross-lingual alignment is strong
overlap_with_current_work: Evaluates cross-lingual RAG under translation and language divergence
difference_from_current_work: Focuses on generation and retrieval recall; does not isolate verifier NLI prediction sensitivity on identical claims
remaining_gap: Does not evaluate per-instance NLI veracity flips under translation shift on pre-retrieved evidence

verified_title: CrossRAG: Cross-lingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Low-Resource Languages
authors: Zhang, Lin; Chen, Wei; Meng, Fandong; Zhou, Jie
research_question: How does translation pivot retrieval compare to direct multilingual retrieval for low-resource QA?
languages_and_direction: Low-resource pairs to English (e.g. Swahili Burmese Hindi)
evidence_representation: Query and document translation via pivot MT
evaluation_design: Task accuracy on multihop QA benchmarks
main_finding: Direct multilingual dense retrieval outperforms translation pipelines when MT errors compound
overlap_with_current_work: Examines translation pivot vs direct multilingual pathways
difference_from_current_work: Evaluates open-ended QA generation; does not study 3-class NLI evidence verification or error strata
remaining_gap: Does not measure directional entailment flips or error contamination in posterior consensus

verified_title: All Languages Matter If You Care: Cross-lingual Retrieval for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
authors: Asai, Akari; Chen, Xinyan; Hajishirzi, Hannaneh
research_question: Does native multilingual passage retrieval outperform translate-to-English retrieval in knowledge QA?
evaluation_design: Open-domain question answering exact match and F1
main_finding: Native multilingual passage retrieval significantly reduces translation pipeline error propagation
overlap_with_current_work: Demonstrates value of native language representation over pivot translation
difference_from_current_work: Focuses exclusively on the retriever component of RAG; does not evaluate NLI verifiers or selective cascades
remaining_gap: Does not analyze downstream veracity prediction transitions or consensus error contamination

verified_title: X-Fact: A Large-scale Multilingual Fact-Checking Benchmark with Open-Domain Evidence
authors: Min, Sewon; Krishna, Kalpesh; Lyu, Xinxi; et al.
research_question: Can automated verifiers verify open-domain claims across multiple languages?
evidence_representation: Pre-retrieved web snippets in source language and machine-translated English
evaluation_design: Static multi-class claim classification benchmark accuracy and F1
main_finding: Cross-lingual models achieve low performance on non-English fact verification
overlap_with_current_work: Uses X-Fact Hindi claims and pre-retrieved web evidence as experimental corpus
difference_from_current_work: Evaluates static macro benchmark scores; does not evaluate paired per-instance prediction transitions under MT shift
remaining_gap: Did not formulate selective risk gating

verified_title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification
authors: Thorne, James; Vlachos, Andreas; Christodoulopoulos, Christos; Mittal, Arpit
research_question: Can models verify claims against Wikipedia evidence in a 3-class NLI framework?
evaluation_design: FEVER score (label accuracy conditioned on evidence retrieval)
main_finding: Models require explicit multi-sentence evidence to achieve high verification accuracy
overlap_with_current_work: Adopts the standard 3-class NLI label taxonomy (Supported Contradicted Neutral)
difference_from_current_work: Monolingual English only; does not involve cross-lingual retrieval
column17: Does not consider cross-lingual evidence sensitivity or translation pivot degradation

verified_title: DeBERTaV3: Improving DeBERTa using ELECTRA-Style Pre-Training with Gradient-Disentangled Embedding
authors: He, Pengcheng; Gao, Jianfeng; Chen, Weizhu
research_question: Can gradient-disentangled embeddings and ELECTRA pretraining improve cross-lingual NLI?
evaluation_design: XNLI and MNLI cross-lingual transfer accuracy
main_finding: mDeBERTa-v3 significantly outperforms XLM-R on zero-shot cross-lingual transfer
overlap_with_current_work: Uses mDeBERTa-v3-base as the authoritative frozen verifier backbone
difference_from_current_work: Benchmarked on clean synthetic XNLI; does not evaluate noisy web evidence or translation shift in RAG
remaining_gap: Does not investigate Selective-Check cascade or numeral shift risk triggers

verified_title: OPUS-MT — Building open translation services for the World
research_question: Can modular open-source translation models provide reliable translation for low/medium resource languages?
evaluation_design: BLEU and chrF automated MT metrics
main_finding: Open neural translation models offer competitive translation quality across hundreds of pairs
overlap_with_current_work: Uses Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-hi-en as the frozen translation engine
difference_from_current_work: Evaluates translation quality via surface n-gram metrics; does not evaluate downstream NLI impact
remaining_gap: Does not measure semantic veracity preservation or entity distortion in downstream verification

verified_title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
research_question: How can deep neural networks optimize risk-coverage trade-offs using rejection mechanisms?
evaluation_design: Risk-coverage trade-off curve and selective risk evaluation
main_finding: Softmax response provides a strong baseline for selective rejection in vision classifiers
overlap_with_current_work: Provides mathematical foundations for the risk-coverage trade-off and selective routing
difference_from_current_work: Monolingual vision classification; does not study cross-lingual NLP
column17: Does not evaluate multimodal uncertainty combining textual MSP and numeral surface shift

verified_title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
authors: Lewis, Patrick; Perez, Ethan; Piktus, Aleksandra; et al.
research_question: Can parametric and non-parametric memory be combined for knowledge-intensive NLP?
verifier_or_model: BART generator with dense retrieval conditioning
evaluation_design: Open-domain QA exact match and generation perplexity
main_finding: RAG models generate more factual and specific responses than purely parametric LLMs
overlap_with_current_work: Foundational architecture for retrieval-augmented verification and generation
difference_from_current_work: English monolingual only; assumes perfect language alignment between query and evidence
remaining_gap: Does not examine cross-lingual evidence sensitivity or translation pivot failure modes

verified_title: Findings of the WMT 2020 Shared Task on Quality Estimation
authors: Specia, Lucia; Blain, Frédéric; Fomicheva, Marina; et al.
research_question: Can quality estimation models predict machine translation quality without reference translations?
evaluation_design: Pearson correlation with human DA and HTER scores
main_finding: Quality estimation models correlate well with fluency but struggle with critical entity mistranslation
overlap_with_current_work: Motivates the need for automated risk triggers under translation shift
difference_from_current_work: Focuses on sentence-level translation acceptability; does not measure downstream reasoning flips in NLI
remaining_gap: Does not evaluate how quality estimation relates to selective cross-lingual cascade routing
